text:
sasha: heads-up: onboarding hit a weird one. toolcall payloads get double-encoded after an auth-refresh retry when we also have request signing enabled. payload arrives as a quoted JSON string to the schema validator.
mino: signed requests? interesting. does the retry layer reapply signing or use the buffered body bytes?
sasha: retry currently replays bufferedText and then re-signs with HMAC over JSON.stringify(bufferedText). since bufferedText was already a JSON string (preserveStrings=true in streamer), stringify wraps it again. downstream validateToolOutput sees a string.
harper: that's nasty because the signing step makes it hard to just swap to the object payload; we need to re-sign the exact bytes.
lee: options: 1) store both rawText AND structuredObject in the stream buffer so retry can choose object path and re-sign the correct serialization; 2) change signer to sign canonical bytes from object to avoid double-encode surface; 3) fallback parse-if-string before validation (risky).
mino: prefer explicit buffer API: StreamEntry { format: 'json'|'text', rawText: string, asObject?: object } Retry can pick asObject and then signer serializes to canonical bytes before signing. keeps signer deterministic.
sasha: minimal repro posted in sample-kit issue. attaching snippet: ```js
// streamer: keeps rawText to preserve whitespace when preserveStrings=true
buffer.push({ format: 'json', rawText })
// retry: fetch(url, { body: JSON.stringify(buffered) }) // double-encodes
```
harper: also note validator coercion makes this worse: if validateToolOutput({items:[]}, {mode:'coerce'}) sees a string it sometimes coerces to array and masks root cause. we should tighten coercion rules.
lee: i'll draft StreamEntry spec and canonical serializer for signing. will add node+py parity tests that simulate auth refresh + signed replay.
ops-bot: created issue #3120: "sdk: signed retry + streaming json-mode causes double-encode seen by validator" assigned to @lee
mino: i'll add integration tests and a temporary sample-kit guard that prefers asObject when present. will revert when canonical signer lands.
sasha: thanks — customer unblocked with workaround but want the proper buffer+signing fix in SDK to avoid more onboarding surprises :thumbsup:
